description: This file defines Express.js routes for handling alert-related HTTP API endpoints, including listing, creating alerts, and managing alert rules, with Swagger annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: router.get('/', controller.list.bind(controller))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/alerts' to list alerts.

methods.name: router.post('/', controller.create.bind(controller))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/alerts' to create a new alert.

methods.name: router.get('/rules', controller.listRules.bind(controller))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/alerts/rules' to list alert rules.

methods.name: router.post('/rules', controller.upsertRule.bind(controller))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/alerts/rules' to create or update alert rules.
